items.title: Route `/settings/tokens` renders TokensSettings
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user with a selected project
WHEN the browser navigates to a URL matching /settings/tokens
THEN the tokens settings screen is displayed at that URL
AND the location, parameters and history behave exactly as in the baseline application

items.title: Route `/settings/create-personal-token` renders CreatePersonalToken
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user with a selected project
WHEN the browser navigates to a URL matching /settings/create-personal-token
THEN the create personal token screen is displayed at that URL
AND navigation is blocked while the form is dirty

items.title: Copy: settings/CreatePersonalToken.jsx (6 strings)
acceptance: GIVEN the settings-tokens screen renders with the default brand in both colour schemes
WHEN its user-visible texts are compared with the baseline application
THEN all 6 strings from this component (for example "New Token") appear verbatim
AND no string is dropped, truncated or reworded

items.title: Copy: settings/PersonalTokens.jsx (5 strings)
acceptance: GIVEN the settings-tokens screen renders with the default brand in both colour schemes
WHEN its user-visible texts are compared with the baseline application
THEN all 5 strings from this component (for example "Personal Tokens") appear verbatim
AND no string is dropped, truncated or reworded

items.title: Journey 23: Settings: create personal token
acceptance: GIVEN the personal tokens tab
WHEN the user creates a token
THEN the token value is shown once and the list updates
AND navigation away with unsaved input is blocked
